messages:
oliver (Partner Ops): Heads up — Channel partner CloudEdge reported a mismatch in the monthly usage CSV we import. Their SKU column is 'product_id' but our import expects 'sku'. They've flagged underreported tokens for Feb.

emma (Finance): yikes. How big is the delta?

oliver (Partner Ops): They say ~12k tokens across 3 accounts (~$1.6k). Attached sample path: s3://partner-exports/cloudedge/2026-02/export.csv

sasha (Engineering): I pulled the sample from S3, the header is:

```
account_id,product_id,usage_tokens,usage_minutes,timestamp
```

our parser expects:

```
account_id,sku,token_count,minutes,timestamp
```

so product_id -> sku and usage_tokens -> token_count is the mapping.

raj (GTM): Is this a one-off contract variant or could other partners be affected?

marta (Cloud Ops): quick scan of last 30 partner exports: 2 partners use 'product_id' naming. Those are CloudEdge and Marketly.

emma (Finance): We need to reconcile and decide credits. Can Eng provide remapped ingest for historicals? We can't issue credits until we confirm amounts.

sasha (Engineering): I can run a conversion script and reprocess Feb exports. ETA 4 hours. Command I'm running:

```
python tools/partner_ingest/fix_schema.py --bucket partner-exports --prefix cloudedge/2026-02
```

oliver (Partner Ops): If you can reprocess, request CloudEdge hold invoices for Feb while we validate? They'll agree to a short hold.

emma (Finance): Approve a temporary hold. Please create a bad-debt/hold ticket and tag me.

sasha (Engineering): Reprocessed. Preliminary delta: +11,842 tokens, $1,459.23. Pushed CSV to s3://redwood-temp/reconciliations/cloudedge/2026-02/fixed.csv

emma (Finance): Thanks. I'll draft a one-time credit memo for $1,459.23 pending partner signoff. @oliver can you confirm partner accepts credit vs back-invoicing?

oliver (Partner Ops): Partner prefers credit memo. I'll send draft and loop legal if needed. :thumbsup: 

aws-billing-bot: Reminder: changes to marketplace-reported usage may trigger AWS reconciliation. Please confirm export to AWS Marketplace team if applicable.

emma (Finance): noted — I'll cc marketplace@aws on the credit memo.

raj (GTM): let's add a quick fix to ingestion to accept both 'product_id' and 'sku' moving forward.

sasha (Engineering): will add tolerant parser and unit test. I'll open PR after lunch.

marta (Cloud Ops): added alert to watch for unexpected headers in partner exports.

emma (Finance): final: created ticket FIN-7861, amount $1,459.23, partner CloudEdge. Keeping thread open until partner signoff.

oliver (Partner Ops): sent draft. partner replied 'approve credit, no legal needed'. closing loop.

emma (Finance): credit applied and invoice on hold cleared. thanks everyone.
